Uniprot Labelled Function: Involved in the uptake of non-siderophore and siderophore sources of iron. Has a role in the retention of iron in the cell wall and periplasmic space.
Notes from Katelyn: Main function is retention of iron. No evidence of adhesin function.
Notes from Dr.He: Involved in the uptake of non-siderophore and siderophore sources of iron. Has a role in the retention of iron in the cell wall and periplasmic space.

Name: CCW12_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Component of the cell wall. May play a role in the formation of a tightly packed outer mannan layer, which protects the inner glucan.
Notes from Katelyn: GPI-CWP with a Flocculin_t3 domain. Function is described as mostly structural, but one publication does mention "ccw12 mutant shows a decrease in mating efficiency and a defect in agglutination."
Notes from Dr.He: contains Flocculin_t3 repeats, may play a role in the formation of a tightly packed outer mannan layer, which protects the inner glucan.

Name: TIR4_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Component of the cell wall. Required for anaerobic growth.
Notes from Katelyn: Publication shows TIR4 is induced during cold shock, and disruptions of TIR4 prevent anaerobic growth. No evidence of adhesin function.
Notes from Dr.He: Component of the cell wall. Required for anaerobic growth.

Name: YPS3_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Cleaves proteins C-terminally to mono- and paired-basic residues. Required for cell wall integrity.
Notes from Katelyn: Hydrolase involved in cell wall organization.

Name: PST1_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Has a partially redundant function to ECM33 in cell wall integrity. May be involved in a repair mechanism activated in response to cell wall damage.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in cell wall organization.

Name: CALX_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Interacts with newly synthesized monoglucosylated glycoproteins in the endoplasmic reticulum. It may act in assisting protein assembly and/or in the retention within the ER of unassembled protein subunits. It seems to play a major role in the quality control apparatus of the ER by the retention of incorrectly folded proteins.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in unfolded protein binding.

Name: DSE2_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Involved in pseudohyphal growth, cell wall metabolism and required for the separation of the mother and daughter cells.
Notes from Katelyn: In the publications linked by UniProt, the gene YHR143W which encodes DSE2 is involved in diploid cell separation. Somewhat unclear, but probably not an adhesin.
Notes from Dr.He: mother-daughter cell separation

Name: MNL1_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Alpha-1,2-specific exomannosidase involved in endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation (ERAD). Delivers misfolded glycoproteins to proteasomes. Forms a complex with PDI1 to process unfolded protein-bound Man8GlcNAc2 oligosaccharides to Man7GlcNAc2, promoting degradation in unfolded protein response.
Notes from Katelyn: Hydrolase involved in unfolded protein response.

Name: HKR1_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: osmosensor activity (1->3)-beta-D-glucan biosynthetic process. cellular bud site selection. fungal-type cell wall organization. hyperosmotic response. osmosensory signaling pathway via Sho1 osmosensor. signal transduction involved in filamentous growth
Notes from Katelyn: Described as a transmembrane mucin, not a GPI-CWP. Has many functions unrelated to adhesins.
Notes from Dr.He: Cell surface sensor protein regulating __glucan synthesis and axial budding pattern.

Name: MID2_YEAST
PFAM Domain Description: Mid2 like cell wall stress sensor
Uniprot Labelled Function: Cell wall stress sensor. Involved in activation of a response that includes both stress-related increased chitin synthesis and the MPK1 mitogen-activated protein kinase cell integrity pathway. High-copy activator of the SKN7 transcription factor. Required during induction of MPK1 tyrosine phosphorylation under a variety of stress conditions. Required for PKC pathway activation under low pH conditions. Required for cell integrity signaling during pheromone-induced morphogenesis. Activates ROM1 or ROM2 catalyzed guanine nucleotide exchange toward RHO1 in cell wall integrity signaling.
Notes from Katelyn: Very well annotated cell wall stress sensor. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: PRY2_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Secreted protein required for efficient export of lipids such as acetylated sterols. Acts in detoxification of hydrophobic compounds.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in fatty acid transport. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: WSC4_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Involved in protein transmembrane transporter activity, response to heat
Uniprot Evidence: Inferred from mutant phenotype / Inferred from genetic interaction
Notes from Katelyn: Cell wall integrity and stress response component. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: CSS1_YEAST
PFAM Domain Description: Hyphally regulated cell wall protein N-terminal
Uniprot Labelled Function: Secreted protein that may be involved in cell wall organization and biosynthesis. Inferred from biological aspect of ancestor: protein phosphatase 1 binding. Electronically annotated as involved in membrane fusion, signal transduction, and vesicle-mediated transport.

Name: SIM1_YEAST

Notes from Katelyn: Hydrolase involved in cell wall organization. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: ULI1_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Involved in the unfolded protein response (UPR), a transcriptional response which up-regulates genes that enable cells to cope with misfolded, endoplasmic reticulum-retained proteins. UPR is part of the endoplasmic reticulum quality control (ERQC) which prevents the exit of misfolded secretory and membrane proteins from the endoplasmic reticulum.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in ER unfolded protein response. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: NCA3_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Involved in the mitochondrial expression of subunits 6 and 8 of the F0-F1 ATP synthase. Involved in fungal-type cell wall organization, proton motive force-driven mitochondrial ATP synthesis.

Notes from Katelyn: Involved in ATP synthesis. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: SCW11_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Involved in cell separation.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in cell separation. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: MTL1_YEAST
PFAM Domain Description: Mid2 like cell wall stress sensor
Uniprot Labelled Function: Involved in cell integrity signaling during vegetative growth at elevated temperature. Acts positively on the PKC1-MAPK pathway. Cell membrane sensor of oxidative stress in the cell integrity pathway upstream of PKC1. Required to transmit the oxidative signal to SLT2 and to restore the correct actin organization following oxidative stress. Multicopy suppressor of 1,3-beta-glucan synthase (GS) mutation. Also suppresses RGD1 null mutations.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in the stress response and in fungal cell wall organization. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: SUN4_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Involved in the remodeling of the cell wall during the various phases of yeast culture development and under various environmental conditions and plays a role in septation.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in cell septation process. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: WSC2_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: transmembrane signaling receptor activity, response to heat, Rho protein signal transduction, cell wall organization
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in signaling and stress response. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: SLG1_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: Plays a role during G1 to regulate entering or exiting the cell cycle. Involved in stress responses. Has a role in cell wall integrity signaling. Important regulator of the actin cytoskeleton rearrangements in conditions of cell wall expansion and membrane stretching. Specifically required for the actin reorganization induced by hypo-osmotic shock. Multicopy suppressor of 1,3-beta-glucan synthase (GS). Activates GS upstream of RHO1. Acts positively on the PKC1-MAPK pathway. Activates transiently SLT2 during alkaline stress, which leads to an increase in the expression of several specific genes.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in transmembrane signaling receptor activity, stress response, cell wall organization, endocytosis, and more. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: SRL1_YEAST
PFAM Domain Description: Transcription initiation factor IIF, alpha subunit (TFIIF-alpha)
Uniprot Labelled Function: Required to stabilize the cell wall in the absence of multiple GPI-anchored mannoproteins. Involved in nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process.
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in cell wall organization and metabolic process. No evidence of adhesive function.

Name: WSC3_YEAST
Uniprot Labelled Function: transmembrane signaling receptor activity, response to heat, Rho protein signal transduction, pexophagy
Notes from Katelyn: Involved in signaling and stress response. No evidence of adhesive function.
